title: Pure Flame Swordsman
summary: Flame Swordsman cards and the Salamandra support built around them, with generic staples; the page's Infernoble Knight and Fire King engines are left out. Dark Flare Swordsman, the newest card, sends Flame Swordsman from the Extra Deck to summon itself, then tributes itself on either turn to summon Fighting Flame Swordsman, Mirage Swordsman or Salamandra from the Deck. Fighting Flame Swordsman searches the Spells and Traps, Flame Swordsrealm summons Flame Swordsman from the Extra Deck without Fusion Materials, and Salamandra Fusion and Salamandra with Chain turn it into Ultimate Flame Swordsman. Metalflame Swordsman needs the Red-Eyes card Max Metalmorph, so it stays out.
main: Fighting Flame Swordsman
Starter: searches a Spell/Trap that mentions Flame Swordsman; mills a Flame Swordsman monster.
Dark Flare Swordsman
Newest card: summons itself by sending Flame Swordsman from the Extra Deck; tributes itself to summon one from the Deck.
Salamandra, the Flying Flame Dragon
Equips itself to a Warrior from the hand or GY; searches a Salamandra Spell/Trap when sent to the GY.
Mirage Swordsman
Revives when a FIRE Fusion falls; floats into a Flame Swordsman monster.
Blue Flame Swordsman
Revives a FIRE Warrior when destroyed by the opponent.
Fighting Flame Sword
Quick-Play: searches a Flame Swordsman card, destroys a card in battle, or negates targeting.
Flame Swordsrealm
Summons Flame Swordsman from the Extra Deck once per turn; protects the Normal Summon.
Salamandra Fusion
Equip: turns the Fusion it equips into another Flame Swordsman Fusion.
Flame Swordsdance
Summons a Flame Swordsman Fusion from the Extra Deck when a monster is Special Summoned.
Salamandra with Chain
Flips a monster face-down; from the GY, Fusion Summons by shuffling materials back.
extra: Level 5 Fusion: Swordsrealm's target and Dark Flare's cost.
Level 5 Fusion: equips to a Warrior Fusion for a second attack.
Level 8 Fusion: destroys a monster, as a Quick Effect while equipped.
Generic Warrior Link-2: revives a Warrior when destroyed.
